canonical_title: Zoho Catalyst 3.0 agent-ready full-stack platform launch
treatment: Covered as the Catalyst 3.0 launch. Repeat only for GA/availability changes, material pricing changes, production-scale adoption, new first-party agent runtime capabilities, or major breakage/security findings.
known_facts: Zoho launched Catalyst 3.0 as an agent-ready full-stack cloud platform.
The release integrates AI IDE workflows, Agent Skills, MCP support, AI-assisted workflows and a non-interactive CLI for end-to-end agent execution.
Catalyst Agent Skills are available for Claude Code and Codex ecosystems, and Catalyst exposes MCP connectivity for agents to provision and operate platform resources.
reinclude_only_if: Catalyst 3.0 availability, pricing, or supported agent surfaces materially change.
Zoho publishes production adoption, benchmark, reliability, or security data that changes practical interpretation.
A reproducible material breakage or security issue emerges in agent-driven deployment workflows.
notes: Launch article published 2026-09-02 17:40 IST (21:10 JST), inside the Night window.
